description_en: Modifies the endpoints of a custom routing listener
description_zh: 调用UpdateCustomRoutingEndpoints接口修改自定义路由类型监听的终端节点
kebab_example: aliyun ga update-custom-routing-endpoints --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --endpoint-group-id epg-bp1bpn0kn908w4nb0000 --endpoint-configurations '[{"PolicyConfigurations":[{}],"EndpointId":"ep-bp1dmlohjjz4kqaun0000","TrafficToEndpointPolicy":"DenyAll"}]' --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateCustomRoutingEndpoints

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the GA instance is deployed. Set the value to cn-hangzhou
parameters.help_zh: 全球加速实例所在的地域ID，仅取值cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the value, but you must make sure that it is unique among different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not set this parameter, ClientToken is set to the value of RequestId. The value of RequestId may be different for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the endpoint group to which the endpoints that you want to modify belong
parameters.help_zh: 待修改终端节点的终端节点组ID
parameters.name: endpoint_group_id

fields.help_en:
The ID of the endpoint.

You can specify up to 20 endpoint IDs
fields.help_zh:
终端节点ID。

您最多可输入20个终端节点ID
fields.name: endpoint_id

fields.help_en:
The IP address of the destination to which to allow traffic.

This parameter takes effect only when TrafficToEndpointPolicy is set to AllowCustom.

You can specify up to 20 destination IP addresses for each endpoint
fields.help_zh:
指定可以接受访问流量的通行目标IP地址。

仅当TrafficToEndpointPolicy（后端服务流量通行策略）取值为AllowCustom时，该项生效。

每个终端节点下，最多可输入20个通行目标IP地址
fields.name: address

fields.help_en:
The start port of the port range in the destination to which to allow traffic. The specified port must fall within the port range of the specified endpoint group.

This parameter takes effect only when TrafficToEndpointPolicy is set to AllowCustom.

You can specify port ranges for up to 20 destinations for each endpoint and specify up to 20 start ports for each destination
fields.help_zh:
指定可以接受访问流量的通行目标的起始端口。该端口取值必须属于终端节点组后端服务端口范围。

仅当TrafficToEndpointPolicy（后端服务流量通行策略）取值为AllowCustom时，该项生效。

每个终端节点下，最多可输入20个通行目标的端口范围，每个通行目标最多可输入20个起始端口
fields.name: from_port

fields.help_en:
The end port of the port range in the destination to which to allow traffic. The specified port must fall within the port range of the specified endpoint group.

This parameter takes effect only when TrafficToEndpointPolicy is set to AllowCustom.

You can specify port ranges for up to 20 destinations for each endpoint and specify up to 20 end ports for each destination
fields.help_zh:
指定可以接受访问流量的通行目标的结束端口。该端口取值必须属于终端节点组后端服务端口范围。

仅当TrafficToEndpointPolicy（后端服务流量通行策略）取值为AllowCustom时，该项生效。

每个终端节点下，最多可输入20个通行目标的端口范围，每个通行目标最多可输入20个结束端口
fields.name: to_port

fields.help_en:
The port range of the destination to which traffic is forwarded. The value of this parameter must fall within the port range of the endpoint group.

If you leave this parameter empty, traffic is forwarded to all destination ports.

This parameter takes effect only when TrafficToEndpointPolicy is set to AllowCustom.

You can specify port ranges for up to 20 destinations for each endpoint and specify up to 20 port ranges for each destination
fields.help_zh:
指定可以接受访问流量的通行目标端口范围。该端口范围必须属于终端节点组后端服务端口范围。

输入为空时，表示支持该通行目标的所有端口。

仅当TrafficToEndpointPolicy（后端服务流量通行策略）取值为AllowCustom时，该项生效。

每个终端节点下，最多可输入20个通行目标的端口范围，每个通行目标最多可输入20个端口范围
fields.name: port_ranges

fields.help_zh:
流量通行目标配置。

每个终端节点下，最多可输入20个通行目标
fields.name: policy_configurations

fields.help_en:
The access policy of traffic for the specified endpoint. Default value: DenyAll. Valid values:

DenyAll: denies all traffic to the endpoint.

AllowAll: allows all traffic to the endpoint.

AllowCustom: allows traffic only to specified destinations.

    If you set this parameter to AllowCustom, you must specify IP addresses and port ranges of destinations to which to allow traffic. If you specify only IP addresses and do not specify port ranges, GA can forward traffic to all ports and the specified IP addresses in the destinations.

You can specify up to 20 access policies of traffic for the specified endpoint
fields.help_zh:
后端服务流量通行策略，取值：
DenyAll（默认值）：拒绝所有访问流量访问指定后端服务。
AllowAll：允许所有访问流量访问指定后端服务。
AllowCustom：指定可以接收访问流量的通行目标。
您需要指定该通信目标的IP地址和端口范围，端口范围输入为空时，表示支持该通行目标的所有端口。

您最多可输入20个后端服务流量通行策略
fields.name: traffic_to_endpoint_policy

parameters.help_zh:
终端节点信息。

您最多可输入20个终端节点信息
parameters.name: endpoint_configurations
